newsitem.title: USA: NY/NJ Port Authority OKs $1.2 billion bond issue.
newsitem.headline: NY/NJ Port Authority OKs $1.2 billion bond issue.

text.p: The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey Board of Commissioners voted Thursday to approve a $1.2 billion special projects bond issue for construction of a terminal building at the busy John F. Kennedy International Airport in New York City.
The Port Authority said it expected construction on the new international arrivals building for JFK to begin this year. Details of when the bonds would be sold were not immediately available.
"It's time to stop appologizing for JFK and get about the business of rebuilding it," said George Marlin, executive director of the Port Authority.
The bi-state agency has come under fire for not upgrading the international arrival facilities at the busy New York airport.
